paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Australia
model_annotation: The plot illustrates a relationship between polarity scores and counts. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and represents a linear scale ranging from -1.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at regular 0.2 intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Counts" and exhibits a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000. A blue line with circular markers and a solid line style is displayed, starting at a value of approximately 5000 counts at a polarity score of -1.0 and increasing to a peak of approximately 128000 counts at a polarity score of 0.0. The line then declines to approximately 65000 counts at a polarity score of 0.6.
